scope: Existing diagnostics at all four registered intervals. Group gradients are recomputed after each recorded optimizer step on that same training batch. Do not substitute them for its pre-update gradients; training_gradient_norm is the recorded pre-update global norm. No new model inference, labels, sampling or optimization.
